name: EA Sports FC 27: Ultimate Plus Edition
summary:
Exclusive Pre-order Edition available only until August 31st 2026.

Ultimate Plus Edition includes:
- Up to 7 days Early Access
- Seasons 1 to 5 Premium Passes
- 10,000 FC Points over 5 months
- FUT 85+ OVR International ICON Player Item (untradeable)
- Hall of FUT Player Pick (untradeable)
- Additional FUT Player Evo slot

Also includes the following FC 26 content:
- FUT 93+ OVR ICON Player Pick (untradeable)
- FUT Player Dribbling stats Evo
- FUT Player Physical stats Evo

Plus all Ultimate Edition, The Grounds and Career content.
